artists.name: Zach Lieberman
artists.contribution: Creates drawing and animation tools with code. Co-creator of openFrameworks and co-founder of the School for Poetic Computation.

artists.name: Golan Levin
artists.contribution: Makes computational artworks and responsive environments; teaches generative form, visualization, and experimental interaction.

artists.name: Lauren Lee McCarthy
artists.contribution: Created p5.js, an open-source platform for art and education. Her artistic practice examines social relationships, automation, surveillance, and algorithmic living.

artists.name: Kyle McDonald
artists.contribution: Makes code-based installations and artist toolkits, working with computer vision and machine learning. Previously community manager for openFrameworks.
artists.placement: Computer vision, interactive systems, and artist-built tools. A specific recipe contribution remains to be established.

artists.name: Taeyoon Choi
artists.contribution: Works with programming, drawing, writing, and participatory projects. Co-founded the School for Poetic Computation and helped develop its curriculum.
artists.placement: Poetic computation, learning communities, and the social conditions of making with code. A specific recipe contribution remains to be established.
